sloka: पुरा कृतयुगे राम प्रजापतिसुतः प्रभुः ।पुलस्त्यो नाम ब्रह्मर्षिः साक्षादिव पितामहः ।। ७.२.४ ॥
transliteration: purā kṛtayuge rāma prajāpatisutaḥ prabhuḥ ।pulastyo nāma brahmarṣiḥ sākṣādiva pitāmahaḥ ।। 7.2.4 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, formerly in the Krita Yuga, there was a powerful Brahmarshi named Pulastya, the son of Prajapati, who was verily like Brahma himself.
